input.query: SELECT date_trunc('week', decision_date)::DATE AS week_start, SUM(n_decisions) AS decisions, SUM(n_approved) AS approved, SUM(n_approved)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(SUM(n_decisions),0) AS approval_rate FROM agg_kyc_daily WHERE lower(platform) IN ('ios','iphone') AND lower(doc_type) LIKE '%driv%' AND decision_date >= DATE '2026-03-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT platform, doc_type, app_version, COUNT(*) AS attempts, AVG(CASE WHEN is_kyc_approved THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS approval_rate, MIN(event_date) AS first_date, MAX(event_date) AS last_date FROM fct_kyc_attempts WHERE lower(platform) LIKE '%ios%' AND lower(doc_type) LIKE '%driv%' AND event_date >= DATE '2026-03-01' GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3
